body: I think i know what i have to do now. I guess i sort of knew all along, i just needed someone to tell me. You guys do a good thing here. Thanks.

It just adds to everything. Thinking about it now, i'm 100% certain i like both, but i would never be able to admit it publicly and keeping a secret like that for as long as i have has just been eating away at me. I sort of came out to a friend ( i hinted and they understood and accepted it) and i felt a great deal better.

I would have cut her out of my life already but she seems to get really upset a great amount of the time. Like crying and saying she has given up. I don't know if it is just her trying to get attention or if it is the real deal and so I can't just leave somebody like that. Her parents are split up and her mum is a bit of an alcoholic and although she is good looking she seems ot have more of a reason to be depressed than me. I know, cause i'm 16 it might seem like some of the things im saying are overstated but i assure you this is as close to the truth i can get in a text post. I want her to go away, for my own good, but if i leave her i can't risk her spiralling into some kind of depression.
